# Ignaz Semmelweis — self-test quiz demo
qa = [
    ("What field did Ignaz Semmelweis work in?", "medicine"),

    ("What is note?", "Mocked in life, vindicated by germ theory"),
]

    print(f"Q{i}: {q}")
    ans = input("Your answer: ").strip().lower()
    if ans and ans in a.lower():
        print("Correct.")
        score += 1
    else:
        print(f"Answer: {a}")
print(f"Score: {score}/{len(qa)}")
